title: Elastic modulus: Young modulus, bulk modulus, shear modulus
topicTitle: Elastic modulus: Young modulus, bulk modulus, shear modulus
notes: **Scope.** Elastic modulus: Young modulus, bulk modulus, shear modulus — Elasticity, Physics (class-11-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: elastic modulus, young modulus, bulk modulus, shear modulus · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Stress = F/A, strain = ΔL/L (dimensionless). Hooke's law (elastic limit): stress ∝ strain.
**Fact.** Elastic moduli: Young's Y = (F/A)/(ΔL/L); Bulk K = −P/(ΔV/V); Shear G = (F/A)/(Δx/L).
**Fact.** Elastic potential energy U = ½FΔL = ½kx². Poisson's ratio σ = −(lateral strain)/(longitudinal strain) ≈ 0.25–0.35 for most metals.
